test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2025)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the father of B',

A - B means 'A is the wife of B',

A x B means 'A is the son of B',

and A / B means 'A is the daughter of B'.

How is X related to W if 'W x Z + Y / X - Z'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e5989cce1299d2ff9bbfd27d02f50133324803cc6996916a55eb82177cb0ab.png] 

 
 

 Code Language (A is of B)
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 x
 /
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Wife
 Son
 Daughter
 
 

 

Decoding the Expression: W x Z + Y / X - Z

X - Z: X is the wife of Z.

Y / X: Y is the daughter of X. 

Z + Y: Z is the father of Y. 

W x Z: W is the son of Z. 

Family Tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/838a8459c84899e2149389fe099d040658caf24be41d232839e7c579dedb1e4a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/587711dc3628de74dc188eea07eef2776ec65c2568568249ba45a2ab36b10fdb.png] 

Thus, the relation of X to W is Mother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
